# 3D tilt hover

A card that tips toward the pointer in 3D, with optional glare and floating layers, then eases back to flat.

## Use when

One hero element should feel physical: a product card, a ticket, a profile card.

## Avoid when

Every card on a page, or touch screens without drag. It stops standing out when everything moves.

## Drop it in

Copy the `TiltCard/` folder (`TiltCard.tsx`, `useTilt.ts`, `TiltCard.css`, `usePrefersReducedMotion.ts`, `index.ts`).

```tsx
import { TiltCard, TiltLayer } from './components/TiltCard';

<TiltCard maxTilt={10} perspective={900} smoothing={0.14} lift={1.02} glare>
  <h3>Mission FE-01</h3>
  <TiltLayer depth={60}>Typed props</TiltLayer>
</TiltCard>
```

Props: `maxTilt` (deg, default 10), `perspective` (px, default 900), `smoothing` (0 to 1, default 0.14), `lift` (scale, default 1.02), `glare` (default true), `invert`, `captureTouch` (tilt while a finger drags), `respectReducedMotion` (default true), `onFrame`.

Style it through the card's own class. The hook writes `--tilt-rx`, `--tilt-ry`, `--tilt-scale`, `--tilt-hover` and `--tilt-glare-*` on the card, so a shadow can grow with `--tilt-hover`.

## Design notes

- Keep the angle under about 12°. Bigger angles make text hard to read and feel gimmicky.
- Use it on one hero element, not every card.
- Animate only `transform` and opacity so it stays smooth.

## Accessibility

- Pointer only, and decoration only. The card's content stays plain HTML in reading order, so keyboard and screen reader users get everything; they simply do not get the tilt.
- If the card is a link or button, put focus styles on the card itself. The tilt does not show focus.
- The glare is `aria-hidden`. See [[decorative-aria-hidden]].
- Reduced motion: the card stays flat and keeps only the lift. See [[reduced-motion]] and [[usesyncexternalstore-media-query]].
- Touch: no hover on touch. Use `captureTouch` to tilt while a finger drags, or leave it off so the page scrolls normally. See [[pointer-events]].
